capabilities: Run a localhost MCP server exposing vault_read, vault_patch, and search_query tools
Chat with Claude in a sidebar using your existing claude CLI login
Discover, scaffold, and manage Claude Skills stored as SKILL.md folders in the vault
Connect external MCP clients such as Claude Desktop or Claude Code with bearer-token auth
Mask and rotate the MCP API key stored in device-local storage
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a vault-building or templating tool; note template generation is only a planned roadmap item.
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community plugin registry (manual install only) and desktop-only. The README lists open end-to-end TODOs, including tool round-trips through the chat UI and cross-platform verification. The MCP server binds to 127.0.0.1 only; the chat sidebar is the one feature that sends vault content to Anthropic. UI is available in English and German.
intentEvidence: Existing options each cover part of the problem
motivation: The author writes: "I didn't want another AI plugin where it's unclear where my notes actually end up once I use it." VaultForge keeps its server local, and chat rides on an existing Claude Pro/Max login instead of a new key.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for Claude or MCP clients to access the vault locally, and existing AI plugins can be unclear about where note data goes or require a separate pay-per-token API key.

relations.evidence: no HTTP hop to a separate REST API layer like in the Local REST API + MCP reference setup
gives Claude Code / Claude Desktop live read, write, and search access to your notes

requires.name: Claude Code CLI (for the chat assistant)
Claude Pro/Max subscription or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY configured on the CLI
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, as an alternative to Claude account login

summary: Claude integration for Obsidian: a localhost MCP server giving Claude clients vault read/write/search, an in-app chat sidebar, and Claude Skills management.
